subject: [PATCH 30/60] mm/memory_hotplug: keep private memory out of the auto-movable ratio

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series aims to improve the auto-movable online policy by excluding private memory from its calculations. However, it's unclear whether this change is sufficient to address the underlying issue.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the auto-movable online policy in the Linux kernel by excluding private memory from its calculations. The current implementation counts all populated zones, including those on private nodes, which can lead to over-allocating movable memory. This patch specifically addresses this issue by adding a check to exclude private memory from the statistics used for the auto-movable ratio.
